Source article title: Jaria Jaug
Source introduction:
Report an officeholder change
Jaria Jaug is an at-large member of the Berryessa Union School District school board in California. She assumed office on December 9, 2022. Her current term ends on December 11, 2026.
Jaug is running for re-election for an at-large seat of the Berryessa Union School District school board in California. She is on the ballot in the general election on November 3, 2026.
Jaug completed Ballotpedia's Candidate Connection survey in 2026. Click here to read the survey answers.
